notes: Roach Modbus Tool v1.3.0 - Poll and Slave: several connections at once. Poll: every device has its own connection, so several devices poll side by side; Connect and Disconnect act on the selected device only (there is no connect-all), the status shows how many devices are connected, and the Log names the device of each frame. The Connect to this device banner is gone. Slave: every endpoint has its own listener, so several listeners run at once; devices on one endpoint still share a listener, like units behind a gateway, and Listen / Stop act on the selected device's listener. At most 32 connections per window. Poll and Slave do not run together: switching modes closes the connections of the mode you leave. Poll: two devices cannot use the same TCP IP and port, or the same serial port; one IP with different ports is fine, and several Slave IDs on one endpoint go in the device's Slave ID tabs. Adding a device (+) now asks for its connection first. Slave: devices on one listener need different Slave IDs (before, two devices with the same ID on one listener were merged silently); 0.0.0.0 and another address cannot share a port, and one serial port needs one set of serial settings. These rules are checked when you add, edit or import a device and before connecting. Slave: Listen / Stop now follows the selected device. Communication Log: traffic of any number of connections is recorded (it kept at most 8).
